record.one_liner: Gumroad is a platform for selling digital products, with a REST OAuth API for managing products, sales and buyers.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 applications are registered in account advanced settings and issue an application id and secret. A personal access token can be generated on the application page for use on your own account.
record.access_notes: Applications are created from the account's advanced settings page. No paid plan or approval step was seen in the pages fetched; pricing page was not checked.
record.api_notes: Documented scopes include write access for marking sales as shipped and editing sales (refunds, access revocation, receipts). Full endpoint coverage was not verified.

evidence.quote: The Gumroad OAuth API is based around REST.
After creating an application, you'll be given a unique application id and application secret.
On the application page, click Generate access token to get the token you will use with the API.
Here, you'll see a form to create a new application.
To start using the API, you'll need to register your OAuth application.
An MCP server for selling digital products
